notes.title: Version 1.1.8 Hotfix
notes.notes: This update aims to address various stability issues and (hopefully) remedies some potential crashes.

notes.title: Version 1.1.7
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.7 contains the following changes:
- Addressed a crash involving particles
- Various performance improvements

notes.title: Version 1.1.6
notes.notes: This small update fixes Steam screenshot functionality.  Press F12 to take a screenshot!

notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.5 contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where music would sometimes overlap
[*]Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze when deleting save data
[*]Fixed a bug where popup messages appeared under other elements
[*]Addressed a potential crash related to the color guide
[*]Addressed a potential crash related to particles
[*]Fixed a crash related to drawing worlds
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
This update contains the following changes:
- Fixed a crash that could occur when resetting levels from older save files
- You can now press alt + mouse wheel to scroll through colors
- Updated the controls menu
- Particle performance and appearance have been improved
- More overall performance improvements

notes.title: Small update to version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.3 contains the following changes:
[list]
[*] You can now replay a level after completing it. This allows you to get missed achievements without having to reset your entire game progress.
[*] Fixed a bug with popup messages and re-enabling the tutorial.
[*] Minor performance updates
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch to fix crashing issue
notes.notes: A bug introduced in 1.1.1 that caused crashes for some users has been addressed

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your continued support!
Here all the changes in the 1.1.1 update, in no particular order:
[list]
[*] All levels are now unlocked from the start.  If you have an old version, all locked levels will now unlock.
[*] Added anti-aliasing and v-sync.  Both are enabled by default.
[*] Brush resizing is less restrictive now, and the maximum brush size has been increased.
[*] Added a setting to re-enable the tutorial.
[*] Added a setting to show/hide the brush sizer.
[*] Added a setting to show/hide color numbers.
[*] Added a fade effect to the settings menu.
[*] Added new SFX to level selection and the settings menu.
[*] The settings menu can now be accessed from the title screen.
[*] Color switching now switches to the next available color, instead of the first.
[*] Added a full controls menu, accessible from the settings menu.
[*] Various performance improvements
[*] Added 3 new achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: Yet another small bug patch
notes.notes: Yet another update to the previous bug fix

notes.title: Fixed a bug with achievements not unlocking properly
notes.notes: A bug where sometimes achievements would not unlock properly upon world completion has been addressed.
